## `get_global_default_analyst`

*Available in [R](#get_global_default_analyst-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to get the default analyst.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_global_default_analyst()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    The default analyst or an empty string if not set.
